text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Do you happen to know 
of a Japanese restaurant we could reserve 
entirely?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
One of my comrades in the club 
is set to make her debut soon, you see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I was told a celebration can wait 
until proper results are achieved. But—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I wish to celebrate. 
My comrade's onward leap.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I must see to the preparations. 
Things are growing busy.
